memories.content: Amara is the tenant. She wants to hold the increase to 4%. She has paid on time for four years and knows comparable units list about 5% above her current rent. Her lease lapses at the end of next month.

The building has two vacant units. Comparable one-bedrooms nearby list about 5% above Amara's current rent. Gerald proposed a 9% increase; Amara countered at 4%. They are negotiating a renewal figure before the lease ends on 2026-08-31.
